summary: John's 2nd cousin 9x removed via John Thompson (closer than the 3C8R first reported; also 3C8R via Bull Smith, 4C8R via Topping, 3C9R via Brewster — the last affected by the Brewster disproof); husband of Culper spy Anna Strong.
bio: Path: John Thompson → Samuel → Susannah (m. Thomas Strong) → Selah. A great-great-grandson of Bull Smith. Delegate to the Provincial Congress, Revolutionary captain, later county judge; held on a British prison ship. His wife Anna Smith Strong is NOT a blood relative (different Smith family). A Selah Strong of Orange County was executor for James Tuthill Jr. (1756) and witness for Daniel Tuthill (1761) — possibly a namesake relative (not established).

military.note: Held on a British prison ship.

sources: Thompson, History of Long Island vol. 3 pp. 292–297
